rust_declaration.name: trim_ascii_start

trusted_assumptions: The lower std API u8::is_ascii_whitespace returns true exactly for bytes 9, 10, 12, 13, and 32.
vstd slice length, range-indexing, and element-indexing contracts connect executable slice operations to slice views.
rationale: The slice pattern is mechanically lowered to an empty test and first/tail projections; loop invariants prove the removed whitespace prefix, returned suffix, and boundary byte.
